title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.34: Renamed Turn It Around to Recovery and gave it pre-Tuned 1. Fixed Crying Out Loud: clearing negative Vigor (spending it on an attack, or lifting it with Invert/Swap) now counts as a debuff clearing and grants Vigor.
